message:
I remember the last time we had a blackout, and my friend Karen was over. The lights went out, and while I calmly reached for my trusty flashlights and power banks, Karen started to panic like we were in a scene from a disaster movie! I couldn’t help but chuckle a bit because I had everything ready for just such an occasion. We ended up playing cards by lantern light, and it turned into a fun evening instead of a stressful one. 

It’s funny how preparedness can turn a potential crisis into a cozy moment. So, if you haven’t already, maybe stock up on some flashlights and keep a power bank charged, just in case! What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a blackout? 💡
